question: Who is Daniel Hampton?
answer: Practical Supply Chain Planning was founded by Daniel Hampton, a supply chain professional with many years of experience across manufacturing, distribution, retail, and consumer products businesses. He has worked hands-on with inventory management, demand planning, supply planning, and production scheduling. He runs the business as a sole trader in Queensland, Australia (ABN 56 757 743 802). More is on the [About page](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/about/).

question: What free tools are on this site?
answer:
The free tools are on the [Learn page](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/learn/). The [Safety Stock Simulator](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/learn/safety-stock-simulator/) is a 52-week teaching year: forecast, uncertainty, replenishment, then the consequences for service, turns, and cash. The [Own-data Safety Stock Simulator](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/learn/safety-stock-simulator/own-data/) gives illustrative estimates for up to 10 SKUs, from one average weekly forecast, your stock, and your prices. [Starter Forecast](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/learn/starter-forecast/) is a 12-week average of your sales history, written as whole units for each week of the plan. The file stays in your browser. The [DIFOT Calculator](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/learn/difot-calculator/) shows on time and in full for each purchase order line. The files stay in your browser.

The [planning glossary](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/learn/glossary/) has plain-English definitions for time-phased planning: safety stock, lead time, MOQ, forecasting and the rest.

question: Where are the guides?
answer: [Getting your data in](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/guides/getting-your-data-in/) shows which file to export from Shopify, WooCommerce, Xero, QuickBooks or Excel for Practical Stock Planner. Free learning tools and the planning glossary are on the [Learn page](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/learn/).

question: How do privacy and cookies work here?
answer:
The [Privacy Policy](https://practicalsupplychainplanning.com/privacy/) explains what this site collects. Starter Forecast and the DIFOT Calculator keep your files in this browser. They are not sent. The Own-data Safety Stock Simulator runs in the browser and stores nothing.

The home page, the Learn pages and the Safety Stock Simulator can load a Meta Pixel to measure ads for the free Safety Stock Simulator. That Pixel uses an advertising cookie. It does not load unless you accept it. Cookie choices in the footer opens the same choice again. On the Practical Stock Planner page, Paddle may use cookies and device information for the checkout.
